title: Community dye room: preparing cloth
titleZh: 社區染布教室：布料準備
passage:
Document 1 · Class handout
The room runs two dye baths: one for cotton and one for wool. Before class, wash each piece without fabric softener. In class, tie a plain cotton thread around each piece to identify it. For a mixed-fibre piece, follow the bath assigned to the fibre listed first on its care label. If the label is missing, use the test bench instead of putting the cloth into either bath.

Document 2 · Instructor’s message
The test bench will be open during the first half of the class. If your unlabelled cloth needs more tests, you can still take part by using one of the cotton practice squares at the bench. The squares are already washed. Do not borrow someone else’s label or guess the fibre from how it feels.

Document 3 · Owen’s preparation list
Striped scarf: care label shows wool first, cotton second. Washed without softener. Blue remnant: no care label, washed without softener. Plain cotton thread is in my bag. I want to dye the scarf today and keep working even if the blue cloth cannot go in a bath yet.
passageZh:
文件 1｜課程講義
教室有兩個染槽，分別供棉料與羊毛使用。上課前，每塊布都須洗過，不加衣物柔軟劑。上課時，用素棉線綁住各塊布以便辨認。混紡布以洗標上第一個列出的纖維決定染槽。沒有洗標時，先到測試檯，不可把布放進任一染槽。

文件 2｜講師訊息
測試檯在課程前半段開放。若你的無標籤布料還需再測，可用測試檯的一塊棉布練習方巾繼續參與。練習方巾已清洗。不要借用他人的洗標，也不要用手感猜纖維。

文件 3｜Owen 的準備清單
條紋圍巾：洗標第一項為羊毛、第二項為棉。已清洗，未加柔軟劑。藍色剩布：沒有洗標，已清洗，未加柔軟劑。素棉線在我的袋子裡。我今天想染圍巾；即使藍布還不能入槽，也想繼續做練習。
